title: Albania Beach Road Trip: 4 Riviera Spots with Ancient Ruins
excerpt: Discover four stunning Albanian Riviera beaches where ancient castles and ruins meet crystal‑clear waters, all reachable on a self‑drive albania beach road tri…
intro: Arriving at Tirana International Airport? A rental car gives you the freedom to chase both sun and history along Albania’s stunning coastline. From medieval forts perched on cliffs to secluded coves, the Albanian Riviera is a playground for curious drivers eager to blend beach time with ancient stories.

sections.title: Albania Beach Road Trip: Starting from Tirana to Himarë
sections.body: Pick up your AutoConnect Rental car at Tirana International Airport and head south on the A1 before joining the scenic SH8 at Fier. The highway hugs the coastline, offering spectacular views of the Ionian Sea as you approach the Llogara Pass. After the winding descent, the first historic stop is Himarë Castle, perched above the town’s main beach. From the ramparts you can see the turquoise water stretching to the horizon, making it an ideal photo point before you continue your albania beach road trip along the Riviera.

sections.title: Porto Palermo Castle and the Hidden Beach of Gjipe
sections.body: Leaving Himarë, follow the SH8 for another 30 km to Porto Palermo, a small bay guarded by a 19th‑century Ottoman fortress. The castle’s stone walls rise from the clear blue water, and a short walk down the hill leads to a quiet pebble beach perfect for a swim. Continue eastward to the canyon of Gjipe, where a designated parking area drops you at the mouth of the gorge. A brief hike of 15‑20 minutes takes you through pine‑covered cliffs to a secluded strip of sand framed by rugged limestone – a true hidden gem.

sections.title: Butrint National Park near Ksamil
sections.body: From Gjipe, drive south along SH8 for roughly 45 km until you reach the town of Ksamil, famous for its crystal‑clear bays. A short 10‑minute drive inland brings you to Butrint National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site where Greek, Roman and Byzantine layers sit amid wetlands and sea views. Wander the ancient theatre, the basilica and the well‑preserved city walls; the park’s layout makes it easy to explore by car, with clear signage and several parking spots close to the main entrance. After a cultural immersion, unwind on Ksamil’s white‑sand beaches just minutes away.

sections.title: Sarandë Castle and the Sunset at Borsh Beach
sections.body: Your final leg loops back northward, passing the dramatic cliffs of Borsh before arriving at Sarandë. Overlooking the harbor, Sarandë Castle (also called Lekursi Castle) offers panoramic views of the city, the Ionian Sea and the nearby islands of Ksamil. After descending, walk down to the promenade and catch the famous sunset at the nearby Borsh Beach, where a long stretch of golden sand meets clear waters. The drive back to Tirana via SH8 and the A1 takes about 4 hours, giving you time to reflect on a road trip that blended beach bliss with centuries of history.

tip.title: Pro Tip: Book a Compact with GPS for SH8
tip.body: Reserve a small, fuel‑efficient car equipped with an updated GPS system. The SH8 has several narrow, winding sections where local street names change quickly, and a reliable navigator will keep you on track and help you discover hidden pull‑outs and parking spots near the historic sites.

faq.question: Can you drive to Butrint National Park by car?
faq.answer: Yes. From Ksamil, a short 10‑minute drive inland brings you directly to the park’s main entrance, where ample parking is available for visitors.

faq.question: What are the best historic stops along the Albanian Riviera?
faq.answer: Key sites include Himarë Castle, Porto Palermo Castle, the ancient ruins of Butrint National Park, and Sarandë (Lekursi) Castle, each offering unique views and cultural insight.

faq.question: Is a rental car required to explore remote beaches in Albania?
faq.answer: While buses connect major towns, a rental car is the most practical way to reach secluded coves like Gjipe and to enjoy flexible timing for historic stops.
